quarterly_data.quarter: Vertex press release: Vertex Completes Acquisition of Crinetics Pharmaceuticals (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Vertex completed its acquisition of Crinetics Pharmaceuticals on September 1, 2026, after receiving the necessary regulatory clearances and Crinetics shareholder approval. The acquisition brings PALSONIFY (paltusotine), which Vertex calls the first and only once-daily oral therapy for acromegaly (company claim) and which has been launched in the U.S., approved in the EU and is under review by other global regulatory bodies, and atumelnant, a once-daily oral ACTH receptor antagonist in Phase 3 development for congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) and Phase 2 development for Cushing's syndrome, plus several other pipeline programs. Vertex says the deal establishes rare endocrine diseases as its next pillar of growth, that PALSONIFY and atumelnant have the potential to deliver more than $5 billion in combined annual revenue at peak, and that it is expected to become accretive to non-GAAP operating income in 2029; details of the accounting and financial impacts will be given on the third quarter earnings call scheduled for November 2, 2026. CEO Reshma Kewalramani said Vertex looks forward to continuing to launch PALSONIFY globally and accelerating the atumelnant program.
quarterly_data.figure: acquisition completed September 1, 2026; more than $5 billion combined peak annual revenue potential; accretive to non-GAAP operating income in 2029
